shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak client_scopes using Keycloak API

options.name: attributes
options.description: A dict of key/value pairs to set as custom attributes for the client_scope. Values may be single values (for example a string) or a list of strings.

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect C(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with O(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_keycloak_url
options.description: URL to the Keycloak instance.

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: description
options.description: Description for this client_scope. This parameter is not required for updating or deleting a client_scope.

options.name: http_agent
options.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier for this client_scope. This parameter is not required for updating or deleting a client_scope but providing it reduces the number of API calls required.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the client_scope. This parameter is required only when creating or updating the client_scope.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Type of client. The V(docker-v2) value was added in community.general 8.6.0.

options.name: protocol_mappers
options.description: A list of dicts defining protocol mappers for this client. This is C(protocolMappers) in the Keycloak REST API.

options.name: protocol_mappers_behavior
options.description: Determine how O(protocol_mappers) behave when updating an existing client_scope.

options.name: realm
options.description: They Keycloak realm under which this client_scope resides.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the client_scope. On V(present), the client_scope is created if it does not yet exist, or updated with the parameters you provide. On V(absent), the client_scope is removed if it exists.

options.name: token
options.description: Authentication token for Keycloak API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
